paragraphs: Hyman cites the end of the first halakhah of Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah, chapter 2. Seder HaDorot reads “son of Rabbi.”

notes.text: The source’s initials סה״ר remain unresolved; they designate the version or work with “son of Rabbi.” The Rav/Rabbi difference is retained.

The saved named Guggenheimer Avodah Zarah 2:1 paragraph explicitly reads Yudan son of Rabbi. Hyman’s heading has son of Rav and attributes the other reading to unresolved סה״ר. The digital variant does not identify that work or prove a correction to סה״ד. The Rav/Rabbi distinction and source initials are retained without name harmonization.

Hyman (vol. II, p. 618) prints סה״ד, where the supplied text has סה״ר. The consulted digital Seder HaDorot explicitly cites Avodah Zarah 2:1 for Yudan, son of Rabbi, as does the Hebrew text of the Guggenheimer Yerushalmi. The English Guggenheimer translation supplies Aivo in brackets from another witness. Hyman’s heading retains “son of Rav.”
